items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It was a decent band director, Mr. [?] and Mr. [?Polikov]. I remember them.

ctx.x: When you were in high school, did you have a band director who was especially hip to these things?

No, not that – we never talked jazz. It was a decent band director, Mr. [?] and Mr. [?Polikov]. I remember them. We were in the dance band. We kind of ran ourselves. But no, I didn’t have any older guy who said, “Listen to this.” I didn’t. I had my friends, Mike Garson, my first friend, piano player. We hunted it together, maybe. And my friend Steve Lipman. He would come and see Trane with me. You had friends, and they’d say, did you hear this record?, did you hear that record? But I would say, more or less, I…
When did you get to Tristano?
